meta: Learning games for kids from things at home: no need to buy toys, bottle caps and boxes are enough. AI comes up with the games.

muc.title: Toys from bottle caps
muc.text: No need to buy toys: bottle caps and paper boxes at home are enough for learning games. AI comes up with how to play.

muc.title: Name the items, name the goal
muc.text: List five things you have, your child's age, and what you want them to learn, like counting, colors or letters.

muc.title: Ten minutes, clear steps
muc.text: Ask AI for three games, ten minutes each, with clear steps and a way to make them harder.

muc.title: Watch out for small items
muc.text: For kids under three, remind AI to avoid small items that can be swallowed, and always play alongside them.

muc.title: This afternoon's game
muc.text: Look around the kitchen, pick three items, and ask a chatbot for a counting game to play this afternoon.
